rounds.report:
Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (not a Blender protocol reproduction).

Observed in the 24 reference samples: one continuous shot (no cuts) of a hover-bike rider on an orange desert floor inside a dark-red canyon. 0-1.4 s side view, bike moving image-left with a grey/cream dust trail to the right, three striped pillars behind; 1.7-3.4 s camera swings behind the bike, two grey dead trees pass on the left, a small red creature sits far right; 3.8-5.8 s bike veers right (trail to lower-left), camera keeps yawing left revealing the striped tower complex with a pink slab on the left; 6.2-7.9 s camera orbits to the bike's left side, drops near the ground and tilts up at the tall striped towers and sky while the bike looms in the foreground.

Geometry: textured ground plane (procedural speckle DataTexture), vertex-coloured canyon wall ring (lower and pink-lit toward the towers), brown shadow band, striped tapered cylinders for pillars and towers (procedural stripe texture), cylinder-limb dead trees, small red cone clusters, rocks, a dome rock, a tank and a pink slab, two white cloud ellipsoids. Bike: box hull, front nacelle, rear pod, seat, handlebar; rider with torso, hooded head, arms, thighs and shins in a hierarchy.

Articulation/motion: bike follows a heading curve keyed to the samples, integrated deterministically at init (10 m/s); it banks with turn rate, bobs while hovering; rider torso/head react to turns. Dust trail blobs stay where they were emitted and grow with age (absolute-time sampling).

Camera: per-sample keyframes of orbit yaw, distance, height and bike screen position, interpolated with monotone cubics; scenery positions are anchored to the camera pose at the samples where they were observed. Timing follows metadata (60 fps, 474 frames, 7.9 s).

Inference vs observation: motion between samples, world distances, speed and the 3D layout are inferred. No render feedback received yet (initial round).

Submission (round 7): submitting the round 6 render. In that render the trees pass on the left by 4.1 s and the overall composition follows the reference timeline. Remaining discrepancies: the dead trees look thinner and a little further away than in the reference at 3.4 s; the dome and left tower peek in at the left edge around 2-4.5 s, before they appear in the reference; the terrain is flat, so the rising dune and the bike's climb near the towers are only approximated by camera pitch and a slight nose-up; the tower complex uses simple stacked cylinders without the overhangs and rooftop props; the trail is made of separate faceted blobs rather than one continuous smoke/dust band; colours are roughly calibrated by sampling rendered pixels. World distances, speed and motion between samples are inferred, not observed.
